reason: A Git and GitHub pull-request workbench that combines CLI-backed repository operations, text-file editing, model tools, and a web sidebar; files-terminal is the primary category because local repository and terminal workflows are central.

summaries.zh: 为智能体和开发者提供集成式 Git 与 GitHub Pull Request 工作台，支持仓库查看、文件编辑、分支与提交操作以及拉取请求管理。
summaries.en: An integrated Git and GitHub pull-request workbench for repository inspection, text-file editing, branch and commit operations, and pull-request management.

capabilities: Reads repository status, diffs, history, branches, and text files
Stages, unstages, restores, commits, creates, switches, and deletes branches
Fetches, pulls, and pushes Git changes
Lists, views, creates, edits, checks out, merges, and comments on GitHub pull requests
Provides model-facing tools and an integrated web sidebar for Git and pull-request workflows
